description: No default language. A quiz client offers its languages in a fixed order (English, then German). The language it speaks is the learner's stored choice; without one, the first tag of the browser's language list (BCP 47, preference order, case-insensitive) whose primary language subtag is offered is preselected; when the list names no offered language nothing is assumed: the client shows only a chooser with every offered language in its own language, the document names no language (no `lang` on the root element, each part tagged) and the title is the word for language in every offered language joined by ' · '. Once a language is known, the root element's `lang`, the document title ('<screen> · <catalog title>', the loading text until the catalog arrived) and every text follow it.
